bio: I am a joint PhD student (2023–2027, expected) working on the Food–Water–Ecosystem (F–W–E) nexus in China.
My research integrates remote sensing, reanalysis/hydrological products and spatial statistics to understand how agricultural changes affect groundwater sustainability and ecosystem risks.
research_interests: China-scale soil erosion modelling (RUSLE) and driver attribution
GeoAI / big Earth data analytics (GEE, Python)
